_description: Age 73, Traditional $500k + Taxable $100k, no spending. RMD is forced entirely as excess and reinvested into the existing taxable account.
_rationale: RMD at 73 = 500000/26.5 = 18867.92. With $0 spending but RMD forced, the withdrawal from Traditional is ~18868. The RMD is taxable ordinary income; taxes are paid from the withdrawal itself (the spending-based withdrawal converges to cover the tax). The remainder (rmdExcess = rmdRequired - taxPortionWithdrawal) is deposited to the taxable account. Florida, no state tax, single filer.
name: RMD Excess to Existing Taxable
